data.summary: I am a full-time, full-service real estate agent with more than 20 years of experience in real estate marketing and photography. For sellers, I provide exceptional photos, videos, and 360 virtual tours to showcase properties at every price point. This helps to attract more qualified offers, and to sell your property faster and for more money. For buyers, I am the perfect blend of tech-savvy and old-school values. I pride myself on providing the personal time, care, attention, and resources you will need to navigate a first home purchase, a vacation home purchase, or for a primary residence or investment property purchase. I am with you every step of the way, both in person or via professional video tours, and online communication for local and out-of-state buyers.
